name: zeroclaw-chatgpt
description: Set up a local ZeroClaw agent with a signed ChatGPT plan grant and an explicit risk preset.

interface.longDescription: Create a fresh local ZeroClaw instance in ChatGPT Work or Codex with terminal and browser access. Sign in with ChatGPT, choose a risk preset for this instance, and bind an agent to the signed plan grant. Validation consumes the selected account's ChatGPT allowance. Requires a ZeroClaw release with native-onboard and ChatGPT plan function tools. No hosted infrastructure or credential import.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up a new local ZeroClaw instance using my ChatGPT plan.
